notes: 只读原图参考提取：未载入游戏配置，也未执行原图脚本或原生 DLL。
原图缓存的发行版本未知；文件名、SHA256 和 JASS 导出时间只用于确定本次快照。
全部单位包含英雄、建筑和辅助物；分类页只列已通过脚本确认的出生用途，不能把1370条全部视为怪物。
SLK HP、攻击基数组件、含骰子武器区间、出生后 setter 乘积分别列出；攻击基数不等于面板攻击或最终实伤。
英雄 HP 预测包含 Misc.StrHitPointBonus 和初始 STR；原生取整、英雄升级、技能、装备、光环和伤害事件仍需实机验证。
217项菜单模式相容的难度不代表账号全部解锁；另有18项公式分支不与该模式选择入口相容。
主难度公式235条；另存64条旧按钮或未绑定分支，不能将其覆盖主分支或当作新增难度。
名义波次组合假设全局波次未被下一波改写且未使用终局快捷道具；极寒部分难度会存在计时器重叠。
前三波首次计时回调只扣剩余数、不出生；天灾普通/精英为随机试验次数，不能把概率换算为固定怪物数量。
存档挑战的 SLK 乘积已经乘过入场物品 scale；不可再次乘 scale 或难度倍率，也不可冒充原生面板最终值。
现有 human_spec 与用户修正版继续作为游戏契约；原图差异只登记，不自动覆盖。
十戒后四只原图 HP 比用户修正版多4960；保留现有游戏修正。首次生成与重生分支差别按原图分别记录。
属性赋值索引是静态调用清单，不代表所有技能、升级、装备及事件已完成语义还原。

waves: No original map release string has yet been identified; archive hash identifies this snapshot, not a release number.
Mathematical difficulty-loop results preserve exact decimal coefficients; Warcraft JASS real arithmetic may incur single-precision rounding. No engine execution was used.
Player relic/archive modifier flags and endgame item shortcut are separate from baseline wave formulas. Full archive index9/key102 item name is not resolved in this wave-only extraction.
Main-chain first timer iteration on waves 1/2/3 emits no unit; actual units are configured iterations minus one. This is recorded as source behavior, not silently corrected.
The endgame shortcut uses a duplicated spawn callback with differing boss mode condition and celestial spawn count; it must not be merged into baseline rules.
wave_reference: HP SLK product and native HP prediction are different columns. Hero prediction adds explicit Misc STR HP before the spawn multiplier; no native engine is executed.

Attack values predict only the SLK damage-base component passed through the base setter. They are not final panel damage, dice ranges, primary-attribute bonuses, armor-adjusted damage or combat-event damage.
Armor floor uses mathematical floor on predicted native armor, including negative values. Missing coefficients or attributes remain unresolved rather than defaulting to zero.
No optional player modifier or divergent endgame shortcut is silently applied. Applicable flags and their source rules are listed separately.
Scourge ordinary and elite rows are alternative branches for each trial; neither row count is a fixed50-percent allocation.
Counts are nominal per-timer compositions. Original callbacks read global wave; overlap and same-timestamp warnings are preserved per row.
All supplied N-label-matched formula rows are retained, including mode-hidden tiers. Dialog availability is recorded in the difficulty provenance.
Exact decimal mathematics is a reference prediction; original JASS real arithmetic and native state rounding can differ.

challenges.fact: A054/A055 and A056/A057 pass the same trigger condition but toggle abilities/flags; their action branches do not create challenge monsters. They are not missing monster definitions.
mode6/7 initial attack multiplier=3+N; generic respawn multiplier=1.8+0.2N. This is present in the original source and has not been silently repaired.
Advanced materials rebuild always uses3+N; initial preplacement and generic respawn use different mode branches.
h091 also has Name=无欲 but is absent from all literal CreateUnit sites and wxAA/QAAA arrays. Active ten-commandment5 is h08U. h091 must not substitute for it.

Native ConvertUnitState0x12 semantics and hero attribute/gameplay-constant effects are not engine-executed here. All data preserves dmgplus1,dice,sides,hero primary attributes and exact runtime expressions.

units.name_plain: 钻地的阿卡那瑟德刺人

baseline_stat_names.attack: native UnitState(0x12), object dmgplus1 is only read explicitly in fallback damage/summon formulas

native_base_caveat.description: These spawn formulas multiply the newly created unit native state. Hero assault bosses have additional native attribute-derived HP/armor/damage and attack dice. Object SLK HP and dmgplus1 are not by themselves a proof of the complete native initial value.

dead_scourge_rotation_copy.description: The mode3 rotation block under else(mode3) can never be reached; actual scourge takes its dedicated random elite/ordinary branches.

actual_count.other_non_boss_waves: timer_iterations; includes 1 leader on eligible wave
actual_count.boss_waves: timer_iterations; includes 1 assault boss, ordinary callback runs timer_iterations - 1 times

mutable_player_flags.effect: next assault-boss attack multiplied by 0.5; flag consumed/reset false
speed set to 522 for boss/leader/ordinary; native state0x51 set1.3 for ordinary branch. Expiring flag does not itself restore stats on already spawned units.
add ability Apiv to boss/leader/ordinary. Expiring flag does not itself remove ability from already spawned units.

attack_event_low_native_attack_fallback.conditions: native attack damage, enemy of Player0, native attack <=10, no special ability A06G
attack_event_low_native_attack_fallback.scope: An additional UnitDamageTarget call in this branch; not evidence that the entire final native hit equals this expression.

global_damage_event_corrections.scope: Additional combat-event rules, independent of spawn stat multipliers. Ability IDs and target/player state matter; this is not a native simulation of every final hit.
global_damage_event_corrections.damage_at_entry: GetEventDamage(), optionally adjusted before percentage stage
global_damage_event_corrections.later_overrides: Player home protections, shields, lethal-damage protections and special challenge immunity can change event damage afterwards; ordered raw writes retained separately.

endgame_shortcut.condition: final-boss countdown not started and shortcut not active
endgame_shortcut.sets_wave: 25 if N1 else30, sets pBAA=true and pauses ordinary wave timer

archive_flag_modifier.effect: multiply HP/armor/attack by0.5 after baseline role factors on all shortcut spawned roles

wave_binding_timing.description: Every spawn timer callback reads global udg_BC, not a saved wave index. In cold N11–19 the60*2s timer lasts120s while next wave starts at90s; later ticks therefore use next global wave. Cold N1–10 is exactly90s and callback ordering at the boundary is not established by static extraction.

office_mode.name: 上班
office_mode.description: Separate UI path; not a baseline 常规N1 coefficient row.

bands.unit_count_scope: nominal count per timer, not a captured-wave guarantee; callback reads global udg_BC at each tick

neutral_respawn.eligibility: dead neutral && SLK.points!=100 && original saved x!=0 && ability A09B absent
sequence: create a fresh unit of same rawID at saved x/y
neutral_respawn.no_accumulation: A fresh CreateUnit precedes the setters; no multiplication of a previously scaled corpse.

sequence: for each of7 regions spawn1 blueprint and3 paired material mobs
multiply current native attack base,armor,maxHP; full life; save original position
advanced_material_rebuild.note: Unlike initial neutral and neutral respawn, the rebuild does not branch by mode for attack.

four_rooms.count_scope: per_player_per_room, spawned only when its group is empty
four_rooms.no_double_scale: All four raws have SLK.points=100 and are excluded by the global neutral initial filter.
four_rooms.lethal_handling: Ability A05V intercepts lethal damage: eventDamage=0, hide, pause, invulnerable.
four_rooms.lethal_ability_evidence: All four room raws have abilList=A05V in UnitAbilities.slk; see unit_bases abilities fields.
four_rooms.reset_condition: active player, in corresponding room, and room reset gate permits
four_rooms.reset_no_double_scale: HP and attack are not multiplied again on show; armor is replaced from SLK base.

archive_fixed_challenge.eligibility_note: points=100 and spawned for an enemy player, not neutral; no shared neutral multiplier.
archive_fixed_challenge.never_rescale_final_reference: derived_slk_products already include item.scale; no second scale or p/L/o/M.
